skill.name: scan-new-specs
skill.description: DEPRECATED and retired as of 2026-08-20. Do not invoke, and do not schedule. This skill scanned for merged PRODUCT.md specs and auto-drafted docs PRs, which produced documentation for features that had not shipped. Docs for newly shipped features are now triggered by the weekly release and gated on documentation-worthiness by the missing_docs skill in warpdotdev/docs. If you were about to run this skill to find docs gaps, run missing_docs in drift-watch mode instead.

content.user_title: Redirect Documentation Scans to the Supported Workflow
content.value_statement: Spec-triggered documentation created drafts for features that had not shipped. This retired skill explains the failure and directs users to release-gated alternatives.
actual_capabilities: Identifies scan-new-specs as retired since August 20, 2026.
Explains why merged specifications were unreliable documentation triggers.
Directs documentation gap reviews to missing_docs in drift-watch mode.
Directs interactive feature documentation work to write-feature-docs.
Warns against scheduling the retired workflow.
limitations: The skill does not scan specifications or repositories.
The skill does not draft documentation or create pull requests.
The replacement missing_docs skill resides in a separate repository.
The skill provides migration guidance only and should not be scheduled.

output_examples.input: Can I schedule scan-new-specs each day?
output_examples.output: No. Keep this retired skill paused. Use missing_docs in drift-watch mode for release-triggered documentation checks.

output_examples.input: How should I document one newly shipped feature?
output_examples.output: Invoke write-feature-docs directly and interactively. Confirm the shipped behavior before drafting documentation.
It reacted to merged specifications before release and drafted unnecessary or inaccurate documentation without checking documentation worthiness.

best_practices: Run documentation gap checks only after stable releases.
Require concrete documentation-worthiness evidence before drafting.
anti_patterns: Do not invoke scan-new-specs for active documentation work.
Do not treat a merged specification as proof of shipped behavior.
Do not draft documentation for every product change without review.

faq.question: Is scan-new-specs still supported?
faq.answer: No. It was retired on August 20, 2026, and should not be invoked or scheduled.

faq.question: What replaces this skill?
faq.answer: Use missing_docs in drift-watch mode from the warpdotdev/docs repository.

faq.question: Why was the old workflow retired?
faq.answer: It triggered on merged specifications, which could describe unreleased, changed, or abandoned features.

faq.question: How are documentation candidates evaluated now?
faq.answer: The replacement checks stable releases and applies documentation-worthiness criteria before drafting.

faq.question: Can engineers still request feature documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. Engineers can invoke write-feature-docs directly for an interactive workflow.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands or modify files?
faq.answer: No. The current skill contains retirement guidance only.
